Container.Name: Subtitle Edit
Container.Overview: Run native Linux Subtitle Edit in a web browser. Includes FFmpeg, libmpv, Tesseract OCR, browser audio, GTK file chooser integration, persistent settings, and Intel/AMD hardware video decoding. No Wine or virtual machine is used.
Container.Description: Native Linux Subtitle Edit with browser-based GUI access, persistent settings, browser audio, web file management, clipboard synchronization, OCR support, and optional Intel/AMD hardware acceleration.

Branch.TagDescription: Latest tested stable Subtitle Edit release.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Port used to access the Subtitle Edit web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Subtitle Edit settings, GTK bookmarks, OCR databases, downloaded language models, and GUI state.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Media and subtitle files. Select files under /data inside Subtitle Edit.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Numeric ID used to access mapped files. Unraid normally uses 99.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Numeric group ID used to access mapped files. Unraid normally uses 100.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, for example Europe/Zurich.

Config.Name: Browser audio
Config.Description: Stream Subtitle Edit audio through the browser. The browser may require one click before allowing playback.

Config.Name: Host clipboard sync
Config.Description: Synchronize text between the browser clipboard and Subtitle Edit when supported by the browser.

Config.Name: Web file manager
Config.Description: Enable the browser-based file manager for mapped container paths.

Config.Name: Web file manager allowed paths
Config.Description: Paths accessible to the web file manager. AUTO automatically includes commonly used and mapped container paths.

Config.Name: Dark mode
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable dark mode for the browser GUI environment.

Config.Name: Keep application running
Config.Description: Restart Subtitle Edit inside the container if its main window is closed.

Config.Name: Initial display width
Config.Description: Initial virtual desktop width in pixels. Browser remote resizing can adjust it later.

Config.Name: Initial display height
Config.Description: Initial virtual desktop height in pixels. Browser remote resizing can adjust it later.

Config.Name: Web listening port (non-Bridge network)
Config.Description: Internal web server port. Normally leave at 5800; relevant when using a network type other than Bridge.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU device (optional)
Config.Description: Enter /dev/dri to enable Intel or AMD rendering and hardware video decoding. Leave blank for CPU-only operation.

Config.Name: Secure connection (optional)
Config.Description: Set to 1 for direct HTTPS with a generated self-signed certificate. Normally leave disabled when HTTPS is provided by a trusted reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Web authentication (optional)
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable jlesage web authentication. Direct authentication also requires Secure connection to be enabled.

Config.Name: Web authentication token validity
Config.Description: Lifetime in hours of a successful web-authentication session token.

Config.Name: Web authentication username
Config.Description: Optional username used when web authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: Web authentication password
Config.Description: Optional password used when web authentication is enabled.
